 Austin FC hits the West Coast to face LA Galaxy for the team's final away game of the 2026 regular season. The match will kick off at 4:00 p.m. CT/2:00 p.m. PT and will stream live in English and Spanish on Apple TV. On radio, the match will be broadcast live locally in English on iHeart Radio’s Alt 97.5, and in Spanish on Univision’s TUDN Radio Austin (104.3-HD2, KLQB-FM).
 The Player Availability Report presented by St. David's HealthCare is as follows for Austin FC's match vs. the Galaxy.
 OUT 
 Chris Applewhite (quad)
 Jon Bell (lower abdomen)
